thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate and elevated tail latency observed for smart-routing decisions (prod). Pager triggered for oncall rotation. Stats: 5xx routing errors up 18% in 5m, fallback_count spiked. Link: https://observability.redwood/alerts/1915004321

sam (oncall): I’m on it — jumping into routing decision logs now. Anyone with quick context on recent routing policy pushes?

kevin: no policy push in the last 6h from runtime. Rolling deploys completed earlier this morning. I’ll pull the decision traces.

mira: seeing customer reports about model mismatches — some requests are coming back from older quantized variant (v2-q4) when pinned to v3-fp16. Suspect variant resolution fallback is misfiring.

nora: CS saying 2 customers reported hallucinated outputs; possible consequence of wrong variant. CS ticket IDs: #3456, #3459.

sam (oncall): ok — initial mitigation options: 1) disable cross-variant fallback, 2) pin traffic to v3-fp16 for affected routes, 3) increase capacity in region-a. Which is least risk?

kevin: quick check: decision log payloads missing route_tag field for ~30% of requests in the window. If route_tag absent, fallback policy uses default variant map -> could explain wrong variant. Our decision service should always emit route_tag.

mira: confirming: logs show "fallback_count": 2 -> but no indication which variant was chosen or whether region fallback happened. Observability gap: decision-trace level not set for runtime-prod.

raj: I can enable debug traces for the routing service but it will increase logs significantly. Propose toggling for 10 minutes and streaming to ephemeral bucket.

sam (oncall): do it. Also please add a temporary golden rule to pin model variant for customer-facing routes: set `route_tag: customer_v3_pin` and `disable_variant_fallback: true`.

kevin: executed patch: `POST /policies/patch -> { \"match\": \"route in [\"/api/v1/generate\"]\", \"route_tag\": \"customer_v3_pin\", \"disable_variant_fallback\": true }`

incident-bot: Deploy job started -> job-id 1915004350. CI logs: OK -> config applied, policy-reload acknowledged by routing service.

mira: after patch, error rate dropped ~60% in first minute. However region fallback loop still visible for some ephemeral traffic: requests failing in region-b, retrying globally and bouncing back to region-b. I suspect missing region labels in decision logs for those retries.

kevin: found root cause in replay: our retry policy lacked a circuit-breaker when fallback_count > 1; combined with absence of route_tag on initial decision, it kept selecting variant pool that had no available capacity and retried across regions. I'll push a short-term fix to add `max_fallback_retries=1` to the router.

raj: debug traces enabled -> showing missing `route_tag` originates from requests proxied through legacy edge (edge-legacy-3). That proxy strips a header used by our routing decisioner. We're coordinating with edge infra to stop stripping `X-Route-Tag`.

cs-ops: Notifying impacted customers with update. Stated impact: intermittent wrong-model variants and elevated latency; mitigation in-progress.

sam (oncall): live mitigation summary: 1) pinned prod customer routes to correct variant (kevin) 2) enabled debug decision traces (raj) 3) applied retry cap (kevin) 4) edge proxy fix in progress (infra). Please confirm whether we need to page infra oncall.

mira: infra should be paged — edge-legacy-3 is owned by eng-infra pager. I'll escalate if we don't see header preservation in 5m.

kevin: patch applied: `max_fallback_retries=1` -> deployment id 1915004442. Routing loop metric flattened.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert status changed to RECOVERING. Next steps: revert debug traces after 10m, add missing `route_tag` validation to decision-logs schema, create follow-up for retro.

sam (oncall): ACTIONS (owners): kevin -> open PR to add circuit breaker and decision metadata enforcement; raj -> infra ticket to fix edge header stripping (ENGINFRA-1122); mira -> run regression evals against pinned variant and surface any quality deltas; nora -> coordinate postmortem and customer timeline; cs-ops -> customer update sent.

nora: filing incident doc now. Severity: Sev2 (customer visible incorrect variants + latency). Timeline and mitigations will be added.

kevin: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/402 (includes decision schema validation and fallback guard).

mira: quick note — gap: our decision logs only store `fallback_count` and `decision_path` string, not explicit `route_tag` or `chosen_variant_id`. Adding those fields will make future triage much faster.

sam (oncall): agreed. Add to postmortem: 1) missing route_tag in decision logs 2) circuit-breaker for fallback loops 3) edge header preservation test in preprod 4) automated alert for variant mismatch vs pinned config.

cs-ops: customers updated. No escalations so far.

incident-bot: Incident thread auto-archived in 1h if no new activity.

sam (oncall): handing off to next oncall: @kevin please assume follow-up; I’ll update rotation and mark this acknowledged.

kevin: taking follow-up, will own postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
